# Twodragon's Tech Blog - Full Content

> Complete markdown content of all posts for AI agent consumption.
{% comment %}
  Same `superseded_by` filter as llms.txt / sitemap.xml / lazy_data_generator.rb.
  This file is the heaviest surface to get wrong: it inlines full post bodies, so
  including the 30 superseded April dailies alongside the 4 rollups that already
  contain the same stories hands an agent the duplicate text twice, each copy
  labelled with a URL that 301s elsewhere.
{% endcomment %}
